description.value: The study estimated resting-state effective connectivity among default mode, salience, and central executive network regions in cognitively normal, EMCI, LMCI, and AD groups, and tested group differences and associations with MMSE and CDR scores.

spans.text: We used PEB to infer the connectivity strengths for the four subject groups.

design.value: A retrospective longitudinal ADNI-2 resting-state fMRI study comparing four stable progression-stage groups using dynamic causal modeling, parametric empirical Bayes, ANOVA, and linear regression.

spans.text: We selected four types of subjects, whose general inclusion/exclusion criteria are as follows: (1) CN subjects: MMSE scores above 24, CDR = 0, free of memory complaints; (2) EMCI patients: MMSE scores above 24, CDR = 0.5, have subjective memory complaints, abnormal memory functions; (3) LMCI patients: MMSE scores above 24, CDR = 0.5, have subjective memory complaints, abnormal memory functions (more severe compared to EMCIs); (4) AD patients: MMSE scores ranging from 20 to 26, CDR above 0.5, have subjective memory complaints, abnormal memory functions (same as LMCIs).
Data used in this study were obtained from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) database ( adni.loni.usc.edu ).

description.value: The first 10 volumes were discarded; the remaining 130 volumes were slice-time corrected, motion-parameter regressed, realigned, and spatially normalized to MNI space using T1 unified segmentation.

spans.text: The first 10 volumes of each functional time series were discarded from analysis to allow for participant's stabilization and magnetic field equilibration. The remaining 130 volumes were corrected for the staggered order of slice acquisition that was used during echo-planar scanning. The correction ensures the data on each slice corresponds to the same point in time. The preprocessing also included regression of head motion parameters, realignment for head movement, and spatial normalization using T1 image unified segmentation to the Montreal Neurological Institute (MNI) space.
The preprocessing was carried out using Statistical Parametric Mapping 12 (SPM 12, http://www.fil.ion.ucl.ac.uk/spm ) and RESTplus toolkits (Jia et al., 2019 ).
